items.title: File Widerspruch against cancellation of Arbeitslosengeld
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen, Bahnhofstraße 12, 35037 Musterbergen).
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 27.08.2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority (Bundesagentur für Arbeit) in a social-law matter. Deemed delivery under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: 4th day after posting = Mon 31.08.2026 (no weekend shift applies to the delivery fiction itself here as it lands on a Monday). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after deemed delivery, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X, i.e. from 31.08.2026, and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 3 BGB: Wed 30.09.2026. That day is a business day in NW (no holiday), so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). The Widerspruch must reach the Agentur für Arbeit by that date.

items.title: Final Arbeitslosengeld payment for August 2026
items.quote: Für den August 2026 zahlen wir Ihnen noch 1.318,20 €.
items.computation: The letter states an amount still owed to the recipient for August 2026 but gives no specific payment date, method, or deadline. The amount is a payment from the Agentur für Arbeit to the person, and no due date can be determined from the text.

items.title: Arbeitslosengeld benefit cancellation takes effect
items.quote: Sie nehmen am 01.09.2026 eine versicherungspflichtige Beschäftigung auf. Die Bewilligung von Arbeitslosengeld wird deshalb ab diesem Tag aufgehoben (§ 48 Abs. 1 SGB X).
items.computation: The letter states the fixed calendar date 01.09.2026 as the day the benefit approval is revoked, coinciding with the start of the person's new insurable employment. Taken as printed, no counting needed.
